item.title: Frontier Exploration - Experiential Knowledge vs Descriptive Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration: Experiential Knowledge vs Descriptive Knowledge When does the thing itself become the knowledge? When is a description sufficient? The Distinction Experiential knowledge — knowledge that IS the experience: A vacation photo album IS the memory A recorded lecture IS the learning ...

item.title: Best Practice - Balanced Capture
item.description: Best Practice - Balanced Capture Capture what works AND what doesn’t. Complete knowledge includes failures.

item.title: Best Practice - Link Quality
item.description: Best Practice - Link Quality Links should be meaningful, not numerous. Every link should pass the “why follow?” test.

item.title: Best Practice - Minimal Organization
item.description: Best Practice - Minimal Organization Let structure emerge from connections, not from folders. Trust the graph.

item.title: Best Practice - Multi-Path Knowledge Discovery
item.description: Best Practice - Multi-Path Knowledge Discovery For every note, ensure at least 3 distinct pathways to discovery: search, backlink traversal, and tag filtering.

item.title: Best Practice - Multi-Source Synthesis
item.description: Best Practice - Multi-Source Synthesis Synthesize across sources, don’t depend on one. Your synthesis is the value.

item.title: Best Practice - Outcome Over Tool
item.description: Best Practice - Outcome Over Tool The tool serves the goal, not the reverse. Focus on what you achieve, not what you use.
